sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><condition_script>event.parm1 == 'sn_sow_itsm_common'</condition_script><description/><event_name>plugin.upgraded</event_name><name>Expand list on landing page</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[var ootbConfigs = {
    uxScreenRecord: ['b034cf7877410110c05d885d9f5a9912', 'cbc2f24977070110949878dabd5a9935'],
    uxApplicabilityM2MScreen: ['4f45f34a77010110c05d885d9f5a991e', 'f5e6f34a77010110c05d885d9f5a9905', '9df6f34a77010110c05d885d9f5a9912', 'b9e2f20577c30110949878dabd5a99f6'],
    uxApplicability: ['89080439c7003010202818b1c7c2603d', 'a9e74039c7003010202818b1c7c2605e', 'f8d78039c7003010202818b1c7c260ef', '907dfd0977c30110949878dabd5a9901'],
    users: ['46d44a23a9fe19810012d100cca80666', '5137153cc611227c000bbd1bd8cd2007', '681b365ec0a80164000fb0b05854a0cd']
};
var hideListOnLandingPagePropSysId = 'e02cea20e0910210f87715d33d78aa64';
var currentEventScriptActionSysId = '230e0b2c53d942105c7d7dd0a0490ec6';
gs.info('Executing script action - Expand list on landing page');

if (gs.getProperty('glide.ux.user_criteria_enabled') == 'true' && isActiveUsersForSOW(ootbConfigs)) {
    expandListOnLandingPage();
}
disableCurrentEventScriptAction();

function isActiveUsersForSOW(config) {
    var uxScreenRecordSysIds = config.uxScreenRecord;
    var uxApplicabilityM2MScreenSysIds = config.uxApplicabilityM2MScreen;
    var uxApplicabilitySysIds = config.uxApplicability;
    var ootbUsers = config.users;
    var appGr = new GlideRecord('sys_ux_applicability_m2m_screen');
    appGr.addActiveQuery();
    appGr.addQuery('screen', 'IN', uxScreenRecordSysIds);
    appGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'NOT IN', uxApplicabilityM2MScreenSysIds);
    appGr.query();
    while (appGr.next()) {
        uxApplicabilitySysIds.push(appGr.getValue('applicability'));
    }
    var userCriteria = [];
    var ucIncGr = new GlideRecord('sys_ux_criteria_m2m_inclusion');
    ucIncGr.addActiveQuery();
    ucIncGr.addQuery('applicability', 'IN', uxApplicabilitySysIds);
    ucIncGr.query();
    while (ucIncGr.next()) {
        var ucSysId = ucIncGr.getValue('user_criteria');
        if (userCriteria.indexOf(ucSysId) == -1) {
            userCriteria.push(ucSysId);
        }
    }
    var groupSysIds = [];
    var userSysIds = [];
    var ucGr = new GlideRecord('user_criteria');
    ucGr.addActiveQuery();
    ucGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', userCriteria);
    ucGr.query();
    while (ucGr.next()) {
        var users = ucGr.getValue('user');
        var groups = ucGr.getValue('group');
        if (users) {
            users = users.split(',');
            for (i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
                var userSysId = users[i];
                if (userSysIds.indexOf(userSysId) == -1) {
                    userSysIds.push(userSysId);
                }
            }
        }
        if (groups) {
            groups = groups.split(',');
            for (i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
                var groupSysId = groups[i];
                if (groupSysIds.indexOf(groupSysId) == -1)
                    groupSysIds.push(groupSysId);
            }
        }
    }

    var userGroupGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
    userGroupGr.addQuery('user.active', true);
    userGroupGr.addQuery('group', 'IN', groupSysIds);
    userGroupGr.addQuery('user', 'NOT IN', ootbUsers);
    userGroupGr.setLimit(1);
    userGroupGr.query();
    if (userGroupGr.hasNext())
        return true;

    var userGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    userGr.addActiveQuery();
    userGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', userSysIds);
    userGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'NOT IN', ootbUsers);
    userGr.setLimit(1);
    userGr.query();
    if (userGr.hasNext())
        return true;

    return false;
}

function expandListOnLandingPage() {
    var pagePropGr = new GlideRecord('sys_ux_page_property');
    if (pagePropGr.get(hideListOnLandingPagePropSysId)) {
        pagePropGr.setValue('value', false);
        pagePropGr.update();
        gs.info('Setting value of UX page proerpty hideListOnLandingPage to false.');
    }
}

function disableCurrentEventScriptAction() {
    var eventScriptActionGr = new GlideRecord('sysevent_script_action');
    if (eventScriptActionGr.get(currentEventScriptActionSysId)) {
        eventScriptActionGr.setValue('active', false);
        eventScriptActionGr.update();
        gs.info('Disabling the script action as it should only run once.');
    }
}]]></script><synchronous>false</synchronous><sys_class_name>sysevent_script_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2024-03-29 12:03:24</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>230e0b2c53d942105c7d7dd0a0490ec6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Expand list on landing page</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Service Operations Workspace ITSM Common" source="sn_sow_itsm_common">0eef12637311301045216238edf6a75e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Service Operations Workspace ITSM Common">0eef12637311301045216238edf6a75e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysevent_script_action_230e0b2c53d942105c7d7dd0a0490ec6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-25 08:31:43</sys_updated_on></sysevent_script_action></record_update>

    try {
        var inputs = {};
        inputs['sidebar_chat_sys_id'] = current.getValue('collab_chat');
        inputs['record_sys_id'] = current.getValue('document');
        inputs['record_table'] = 'incident';

    } catch (ex) {
        var message = ex.getMessage();
        gs.error(message);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2023-05-16 12:49:21</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>980f295247b2e1503fbe9e25126d432f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>New sidebar discussion created</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Collaboration Services for Service Operations Workspace" source="sn_sow_collab">fa27a0dd53423010bf68ddeeff7b12ac</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Collaboration Services for Service Operations Workspace">fa27a0dd53423010bf68ddeeff7b12ac</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_980f295247b2e1503fbe9e25126d432f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-25 08:30:05</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=980f295247b2e1503fbe9e25126d432f"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><condition_script/><description/><event_name>system.upgraded</event_name><name>OpenNLUPredictIntentFeedbackUpdates</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[gs.info("Starting update of the OpenNLUPredictIntentFeedback table to populate the NLU Discovery Outcome field");
try {
	var api = new UpdateNLUDiscoveryOutcomes();
	api.updateNluDiscoveryOutcomes();
} catch (ex) {
	gs.info("Error running updateNluDiscoveryOutcomes() : " + ex.toString());
}

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><condition_script/><description/><event_name>system.upgraded</event_name><name>Security fix for SC Shopping Cart Dep</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[var scriptPrefix = "fix_security_issue_sc_shopping_cart_deprecated";
gs.info(scriptPrefix + "Started executing the script");
if (!(GlideCollisionDetector.get().containsKey("sp_widget_f3336978dbaca2007f3bf5131f9619ec")))
	addACLChecks();

gs.info(scriptPrefix + "Ended executing the script");

function addACLChecks() {
var script = "(function() {
 var m = data.msgs = {};
 m.createdMsg = gs.getMessage("Created");
 m.trackMsg = gs.getMessage("track using 'Requests' in the header or");
 m.clickMsg = gs.getMessage("click here to view");
 m.cartEmptiedMsg = gs.getMessage("Your cart has been emptied");
 m.itemRemovedMsg = gs.getMessage("has been removed from your cart");
 m.updatedMsq = gs.getMessage("Updated");

 m.quantityToMsg = gs.getMessage("quantity to");
 m.clearCartConfirmationMsg = gs.getMessage("Are you sure you want to empty your cart?");
 var userID = gs.getUser().getID();
 var cart = new SPCart(input.cartName, userID);
 if (input && input.action === "edit_item") {
 data.editVariablesModal = $sp.getWidget('widget-modal', {embeddedWidgetId: 'sp-variable-editor', embeddedWidgetOptions: {sys_id: input.itemID, table: "sc_cart_item", showItemTitle: true, isOrdering: true}});
 return;
 } if (input && input.action === "update_quantity") {
 var cartItemGR = new GlideRecord("sc_cart_item");
 if (cartItemGR.get(input.itemID) && cartItemGR.canWrite()) {
 cartItemGR.setValue("quantity", input.quantity);
 cartItemGR.update();
 } } if (input && input.action === "checkout") { cart.setSpecialInstructions(input.additionalDetails);
 cart.setRequestedFor(input.cart.requested_for);
 cart.setDeliveryAddress(input.deliverTo);
 var request = cart.placeOrder();
 data.requestData = { number: request.getValue("number"), table: request.getTableName(), sys_id: request.getUniqueValue() };
 cart.setSpecialInstructions("");
 cart.setRequestedFor(userID);
 cart.setDeliveryAddress("");
 } if (input && input.action === "remove_item") {
 var itemGR = new GlideRecord('sc_cart_item');
 if (itemGR.get(input.removeItemID) && itemGR.canDelete()) itemGR.deleteRecord();
 } if (input && input.action === "clear_cart") { cart.clearCart();
 } if (input && input.action === "save_cart") {
 var newCart = new SPCart(input.newCartName, userID);
 newCart.loadCart(cart.getCartID());
 } data.sys_properties = { twostep_checkout: gs.getProperty("glide.sc.checkout.twostep", "false") == 'true' };
 var cartID = cart.getCartID();
 data.saveCartModal = $sp.getWidget('widget-modal', {embeddedWidgetId: 'sc_save_bundle', embeddedWidgetOptions: {}});
 data.cart = cart.getCartObj();
 data.cartItems = cart.getItems();
 })();";

	var gr = new GlideRecord("sp_widget");
	if (gr.get("f3336978dbaca2007f3bf5131f9619ec")) {
		gr.setWorkflow(false);
		gr.setUseEngines(false);
		gr.setValue("script", script);
		gr.update();
	}

	var action = new GlideRecord("sysevent_script_action");
	if (action.get("ebaea1cf9cd25210f87722436a15f78b")) {
		action.setValue("active", false);
		action.update();
	}
}]]></script><synchronous>false</synchronous><sys_class_name>sysevent_script_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>maint</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2024-12-10 12:56:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path/><sys_id>ebaea1cf9cd25210f87722436a15f78b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Security fix for SC Shopping Cart Dep</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Service Portal - Service Catalog (do not activate...see plugin description)" source="com.glide.service-portal.service-catalog">344ce2ff292503107f44f3a98c182493</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysevent_script_action_ebaea1cf9cd25210f87722436a15f78b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-25 10:30:58</sys_updated_on></sysevent_script_action></record_update>

	insertOrUpdateDSStatusToInProgress(current.sys_id);
    SNC.PAMLBConversion.enableMLBForAutomatedAndFormulaIndicators([current.sys_id]);
})(current, previous);

function insertOrUpdateDSStatusToInProgress(indicatorSysId) {
	var DS_IN_PROGRESS = "3";
	var gr = new GlideRecord("pa_indicator_data_snapshot_status");
	if(gr.get("indicator", indicatorSysId)) {
		gr.setValue("data_snapshot_status", DS_IN_PROGRESS);
		gr.update();
		return;
	}
	gr.initialize();
	gr.setValue("indicator", indicatorSysId);
	gr.setValue("data_snapshot_status", DS_IN_PROGRESS);
	gr.insert();
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2024-04-04 00:11:26</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path/><sys_id>f6f3e79293110210ff43ac29848918e4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PA ULB Conversion on Enable</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Data Snapshots" source="com.snc.pa.mlb">278132b729e503107f44f3a98c1824e9</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_f6f3e79293110210ff43ac29848918e4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-26 02:00:13</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=f6f3e79293110210ff43ac29848918e4"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><condition_script>event.parm1 == 'sn_itsm_gen_ai'</condition_script><description/><event_name>plugin.upgraded</event_name><name>Deactivate Incident Assist Skill</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[// Deprecate Incident Assist Skill on plugin upgrade
// Uses the Now Assist Admin API to deactivate and archive the skill
// along with any related override and copy skills.

var incidentAssistSkillConfigSysID = "344648751bdc12104eabdc23b24bcbdf";

try {
    gs.info("Deactivate Incident Assist Skill - Starting deprecation process");

    var nowAssistSkillConfig = new sn_nowassist_admin.NowAssistSkillConfig();
    nowAssistSkillConfig.deprecateSkillsWithOverridesAndCopies(
        [incidentAssistSkillConfigSysID],
        true,  // includeCopySkills
        true,  // includeOverrides
        false  // canRestoreCopy - skill is being permanently deprecated
    );

    gs.info("Deactivate Incident Assist Skill - Successfully completed deprecation process");

    // Deactivate this script action so it does not run on subsequent upgrades
    var scriptActionGr = new GlideRecordSecure("sysevent_script_action");
    if (scriptActionGr.get("76147bec2bc8031091f6fc5bf291bf5a")) {
        scriptActionGr.setValue("active", false);
        scriptActionGr.update();
        gs.info("Deactivate Incident Assist Skill - Script action deactivated after successful run");
    }

sys_update_xml.name: sysevent_script_action_015ea1b943f10650ab81a921eab8f2bb
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sysevent_script_action"><sysevent_script_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><condition_script/><description/><event_name>login</event_name><name>Cloudlabs - run setup repair</name><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[if (event.parm1 == 'admin') {
	handleAISAdminUserEnabledFlag();
	disableSelf();
}


function handleAISAdminUserEnabledFlag() {
    if (CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.ML_REPAIR_SUCCESSFUL === 'false' &&
        CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.ML_REPAIR_AVAILABLE_RETRIES > 0) {
		gs.info(CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.LOG_PREFIX + 'Received event "run_cloudlabs_setup_repair". Parm1= ' + event.parm1);
        CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.startSetupRepair(CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.SETUP_ALL);
    } else {
		gs.info(gs.getMessage(CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.LOG_PREFIX + "ML Setup repair not run. Number of retires available {0}. Current repair status= {1}"), 
			CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.ML_REPAIR_AVAILABLE_RETRIES, CloudlabsSetupRepairUtil.ML_REPAIR_SUCCESSFUL);
	}
}

function disableSelf() {
	var gr = new GlideRecord('sysevent_script_action');
	gr.get('015ea1b943f10650ab81a921eab8f2bb');
